author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕಣ್ಣಮುಚ್ಚುವವರೆಗು ಕಣ್ತೆರೆದು ನೋಡುತಿರು
ಸಣ್ಣವಿಷಯಗಳಲ್ಲೂ ಸತ್ಯವನೆ ಬೆದಕು
ಬಣ್ಣಬಣ್ಣದ ಮಾತು ಮರೆಮಾಡೆ ನೈಜತೆಯ
ಸಣ್ಣತನ ಕಡೆಗಣಿಸು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Until you close your eyes, keep looking with open eyes;
search for truth even in small matters;
when colourful words hide what is real,
ignore the pettiness, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Stay alert as long as you live, and seek truth even in small things. When fine words hide reality, look past them and don’t get drawn into pettiness.
